shared_elements: human figures in profile with curled beard and patterned hair
repeated figures aligned along a common groundline in a single horizontal register
surfaces filled with regular repeated texture patterns (brickwork courses / fleece / foliage scales)
figures shown in overlapping file moving in one direction
justification: Both show bearded male figures in strict profile, with hair and beard rendered as tight regular curls, arranged in an overlapping file along a single groundline in a continuous relief frieze, and both fill large forms with dense repeated surface texture (brick courses versus fleece and leaf scales) — a set of conventions specific enough to suggest a shared manner of depiction. The subjects differ completely, however: A is a combat scene of archers and a wheeled siege engine attacking a crenellated walled city, while B is a peaceful procession of men leading horned rams beside a tree above a rosette border.
